units.source_text: 你这样倒不像是个初出茅庐的小子了，也是难得你还是个有点悟性的人。

en.t: You no longer seem like some inexperienced young fellow, and it is rare to find that you are still a person with a little understanding.

units.source_text: 所以，你是说，就算以后生活贫寒，你也要安心过日子了吗？”

en.t: So you mean that even if your life is poor from now on, you will still settle down and live in peace?
